name: Launch Essentials Rulebook
summary: What every real, launched website has: system pages, legal pages, contact details, monitoring.
check: Open every system and legal page; test cookie consent in a fresh browser.
Send a test through every form and check the email arrives.

rules.title: Custom 404 page
rules.text: In the site's design, with links home, to search and to key pages.

rules.title: CTA above the fold
rules.text: The primary action is visible without scrolling on desktop and mobile.

rules.title: Sticky mobile CTA
rules.text: On phones, the primary action stays reachable (for example a bar at the bottom) where it makes sense: product pages, booking, sign-up.

rules.title: Mobile breakpoints
rules.text: Tested at roughly 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920 px. No horizontal scroll, tap targets at least 44 px.

rules.title: Favicon set
rules.text: `favicon.ico` or SVG, `apple-touch-icon` (180 px), icons for Android and the web manifest.

rules.title: Open Graph and social preview
rules.text: `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` (1200 × 630), Twitter card tags, per page where it matters.

rules.title: Thank-you page or state
rules.text: After a form or an order, a confirmation with the next step.

rules.title: Privacy policy page
rules.text: Required in the EU (GDPR) whenever the site collects any personal data, including analytics and newsletter emails.

rules.title: Terms page
rules.text: Terms and conditions, required for shops and services.

rules.title: Cookie banner
rules.text: Needed in the EU for non-essential cookies (analytics, marketing). "Reject" must be as easy as "Accept". Load those scripts only after consent.

rules.title: Analytics installed
rules.text: Plausible, Umami, Google Analytics or similar, respecting consent.

rules.title: Real contact details
rules.text: Real address, email, phone and company ID where applicable.

rules.title: Version control
rules.text: The code lives in a Git repository with meaningful commits.

rules.title: Accessibility basics
rules.text: Semantic HTML, labelled inputs, visible focus, keyboard navigation for every interactive element, `lang` attribute, reduced-motion support.

rules.title: Accessibility statement
rules.text: For sites selling to EU consumers, an accessibility statement and a feedback channel for barriers, linked from the footer (`AX-24`).

rules.title: Company details
rules.text: Legal name, registered address and company ID (in the Czech Republic the IČO, and DIČ if VAT registered) in the footer or contact page where the law asks for them.

rules.title: Redirects from old URLs
rules.text: When a site replaces an old one, every old URL redirects with a 301 to its closest new page.

rules.title: Email that arrives
rules.text: Form and order emails are sent from the site domain with SPF, DKIM and DMARC set up, and tested in common inboxes.

rules.title: Uptime and error monitoring
rules.text: An uptime check and front-end error tracking are in place, alerting a real person.

rules.title: Backups
rules.text: Content and databases are backed up automatically, and a restore has been tested at least once.

rules.title: Launch without a content owner
rules.text: No site ships without someone named who keeps prices, opening hours, team and legal pages up to date.

rules.title: Under construction pages
rules.text: No "coming soon" sections or empty pages in navigation. Ship what exists; add the rest when it is real.
